corrections.reason: DNL310 is AVLAYAH (tividenofusp alfa-eknm), an enzyme replacement therapy rather than cell/gene therapy. FDA approved it March 24, 2026, and Denali reported its U.S. commercial launch underway with patients treated in May. It is not an investigational Phase 3 CGT launch target.
